summary: Completed comprehensive multi-tenancy and tenant isolation testing for AutoBookd SaaS platform. All 29 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed. Fixed one issue in stop_system endpoint that was not tenant-aware.

minor.issue: Was not tenant-aware - used old 'id: system_config' pattern instead of tenant_id filter

critical_code_review_comments: Multi-tenancy implementation is solid - all endpoints use tenant_id filters
User registration and login flow works correctly
Leads, Products, Discovery sets endpoints are properly tenant-aware
Pipeline start/stop is tenant-aware (fixed stop_system endpoint)
No localhost URLs found in any API responses
Authentication is properly enforced on all protected endpoints
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin user data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-tenancy audit completed. All DB queries now use tenant_id filters. The stop_system endpoint was fixed to be tenant-aware. New users will see empty data arrays for leads, products, discovery sets, and conversations. Admin user sees their existing data (78 leads, products, discovery sets). No data leaks between tenants.
mocked_apis_note: None - all APIs are real. Email sending is bypassed in Test Mode.
rca_of_the_issue: The stop_system endpoint was using the old pattern 'id: system_config' instead of tenant_id filter. This was a leftover from before the multi-tenancy audit. Fixed by adding user authentication dependency and using tenant_id from the authenticated user.
